ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory identification of Politically Exposed Persons (PEPs) per FATF standards and Law 10/2010; real-time screening against OFAC SDN List, UN Security Council Consolidated List, EU Consolidated Financial Sanctions List, and Spanish Boletín Oficial del Estado (BOE); enhanced due diligence for high-risk third countries and for foreign PEPs; verification of documentation via notarized copies and public registries.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Registro Mercantil Central (Central Commercial Registry) — www.rmc.es
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: Names must be in Spanish or transliterated to Latin alphabet; exclusive use of Spanish characters is recommended; foreign words may be accepted if transliterated and not misleading; no names in non-Latin scripts such as Cyrillic, Arabic or Chinese.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: If the name certificate (certificación negativa de denominación) is rejected, the applicant may apply to the same Registrar for a different name; a formal administrative appeal (Recurso de Alzada) can be lodged with the Dirección General de la Seguridad Jurídica y Fe Pública (ex-DGRN) within one month from notification; after three months, the same rejected name may become available for reapplication.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Approved for administrative/registered office purposes; however, for a data-center EPC entity, a physical operating address in Spain is recommended to maintain commercial substance, particularly for VAT and corporate tax exemptions.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Low-to-moderate; estimated 15% probability of unannounced on-site inspection per annum given typical Spanish compliance procedures.

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Royal Legislative Decree 1/2010 approving the consolidated text of the Spanish Companies Act (Ley de Sociedades de Capital), especially Articles 4, 19-23, 61-62, 78-80, 210-222, and 247-251; Royal Decree 1784/1996 on the Mercantile Registry; Law 14/2013 and related CIRCE provisions for electronic incorporation.
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: The competent Provincial Mercantile Registry (Registro Mercantil Provincial) of the company's registered office, supervised by the Directorate-General for Legal Certainty and Public Faith (Dirección General de Seguridad Jurídica y Fe Pública).
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Public deed of incorporation (escritura pública de constitución) filed for registration with the competent Provincial Mercantile Registry, generally prepared through the CIRCE/DUE electronic system where eligible.
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: The statutory minimum capital of an Sociedad de Responsabilidad Limitada is EUR 1. Capital must be fully subscribed and paid at incorporation. No statutory escrow account is required. For cash contributions, a bank certificate may be delivered to the notary, although founders may waive delivery and remain jointly liable for the reality of the contributions. Until capital reaches EUR 3,000, at least 20% of annual profit must be allocated to legal reserve until the reserve plus capital reaches EUR 3,000, and shareholders bear supplementary liability up to the difference between EUR 3,000 and subscribed capital upon liquidation.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED, that the Company accept and record the subscription and full payment of its issued shares as stated in the incorporation deed and shareholders’ register. RESOLVED, that the registered office be established at [full Spanish address], with authority for the managing body to update the address in accordance with applicable law. RESOLVED, that [name] be appointed as [sole director/joint directors/board member], and that [name] be appointed secretary, if applicable. RESOLVED, that the appointed officers obtain the Company’s tax identification number, execute registry filings, open bank accounts, and complete all registrations, permits, and operational formalities required for the Company’s EPC activities.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Central Mercantile Registry (Registro Mercantil Central), through its online name-certification service or an authorized CIRCE processing point.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit up to five proposed names in priority order. Obtain the negative name certificate, which is generally valid for three months for execution of the deed and may be reserved for the statutory period applicable to incorporation. Ensure the proposed name includes the corporate form designation or its permitted abbreviation, S.L.
required_dossiers: Power of attorney, if filed by an agent
Foreign shareholder corporate authority documents, if applicable
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the name is rejected, submit an alternative name or appeal the registral decision where legally available. Correct spelling, prohibited terms, similarity, or missing corporate-form designation before resubmission.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Obtain foreign investor and director identification
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Spanish Tax Agency (Agencia Estatal de Administración Tributaria) and the relevant Spanish consular or diplomatic channel where required.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Obtain a Spanish Foreigner Identification Number (NIE) for each non-resident individual shareholder, director, and other persons required to appear in the deed. Obtain a Spanish Tax Identification Number (NIF) for each foreign corporate shareholder. Foreign corporate documents must be legalized or apostilled and accompanied by sworn Spanish translations unless an applicable treaty or registry practice provides otherwise.
required_dossiers: Certificate of incumbency or equivalent authority evidence
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Respond to an information request through the Agencia Tributaria channel or consulate. Cure document legalization, translation, identity, beneficial ownership, or authority deficiencies and resubmit.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Prepare constitutional documents and corporate governance structure
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Founders, appointed Spanish notary, and CIRCE/DUE platform where used.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Prepare the bylaws, corporate purpose, registered office, share capital, share distribution, management structure, director acceptance, beneficial ownership information, and shareholder powers. Select sole director, joint or several directors, or a board of directors. The corporate purpose should expressly cover data-center mechanical, electrical, cooling, construction, engineering, commissioning, maintenance, procurement, and EPC activities, subject to professional and project-specific licensing rules.
required_dossiers: Bank certificate or founders’ contribution declaration
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Revise the bylaws, corporate purpose, management model, or beneficial ownership information in accordance with the notary’s or registry’s observations before execution.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Execute the public deed of incorporation
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Spanish Notary Public (Notario) selected by the founders, with electronic CIRCE processing where available.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Attend or validly represent all founders before the notary. Execute the public deed, confirm capital subscription and payment, approve the bylaws, appoint the managing body, and declare beneficial ownership. The notary verifies identity, capacity, powers, legality, and contribution formalities. Request provisional NIF and electronic transmission to the Mercantile Registry where supported.
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Correct notarial defects, produce missing originals or translations, replace defective powers, and execute a rectifying deed if required.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Obtain tax identification and register the company
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Spanish Tax Agency for NIF processing and the Provincial Mercantile Registry of the registered office.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: File the incorporation deed, provisional NIF documentation, beneficial ownership information, and applicable registry forms. Pay registry and notarial charges separately; there is no single uniform state incorporation fee. After registration, obtain the definitive NIF and collect the registry certification. Register the company for the relevant economic activity codes and tax obligations using Form 036 or the applicable electronic process.
required_dossiers: Proof of payment of registry charges
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Answer a registral defect notice within the stated period, amend the deed through a corrective public instrument where needed, and refile. A registral appeal may be available under the Mortgage Law and Mercantile Registry rules.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Complete post-incorporation corporate, labor, and electronic formalities
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Spanish Tax Agency, General Treasury of Social Security, regional labor authority, and Provincial Mercantile Registry.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Open the corporate bank account, replace the provisional NIF with the definitive NIF, register employees and directors where applicable, obtain an employer contribution account, communicate the opening of the workplace, legalize accounting and corporate books electronically, and maintain the shareholders’ register. Establish internal compliance for occupational risk prevention, subcontracting, anti-money laundering, data protection, and contractor qualification.
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Correct rejected electronic filings, submit missing Social Security or labor forms, and cure book-legalization or tax-registration errors through the relevant electronic portal.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: The competent industrial authority of the Autonomous Community where the project is located, together with the relevant municipality and, for regulated installations, the applicable electricity, building, energy, water, and environmental authorities. Spain has no single national data-center manufacturing or EPC operating licence.
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Project-specific municipal activity/opening and operating authorization (licencia o comunicación de actividad y funcionamiento), supported as applicable by industrial installation registration, commissioning certificates, and sectoral authorizations. Relevant installations may include electrical low-voltage or high-voltage commissioning, thermal installation registration under the Regulation of Thermal Installations in Buildings (RITE), pressure equipment, lifts, fuel storage, refrigerant systems, and construction or building permits.

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: The competent environmental authority of the relevant Autonomous Community, applying Law 21/2013 on Environmental Assessment and applicable regional environmental legislation; the Ministry for the Ecological Transition and the Demographic Challenge acts where state competence applies.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Project-specific screening. A data-center facility is not automatically subject to a full EIA solely because it is a data center; the project must be screened against Annexes I and II of Law 21/2013 and regional rules. Full ordinary or simplified EIA may be required depending on land location, size, power infrastructure, emergency generation, fuel storage, cooling systems, water use, protected areas, and cumulative effects.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Obtain a wastewater discharge authorization where discharge is made to the public sewer or receiving waters; comply with the applicable municipal sewer ordinance and Royal Legislative Decree 1/2001 on Water. Control air emissions from diesel generators, boilers, and other classified sources under Law 34/2007 and Royal Decree 100/2011, including applicable permits, monitoring, and fuel requirements. Manage hazardous and non-hazardous waste under Law 7/2022 and Royal Decree 553/2020, using authorized waste operators and electronic movement records where required. Refrigerants and fluorinated gases must comply with applicable EU and Spanish containment, recovery, leak-control, and certification rules. No universal national VOC or wastewater numeric threshold applies to every project; permit-specific and local limits govern.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Obtain municipal building, occupancy, activity, and opening approvals; prepare fire-protection documentation under the applicable current industrial fire-safety and building regulations, including evacuation, detection, suppression, compartmentation, emergency power, and fire-load controls. Complete certified commissioning and inspections for electrical, thermal, pressure, fuel, lifting, and other regulated installations. Obtain structural, load-bearing, seismic, and roof-loading verification for equipment, batteries, generators, cooling plant, and raised floors where applicable. Establish occupational risk prevention under Law 31/1995, coordinate contractor and subcontractor activities under Royal Decree 171/2004, comply with construction safety obligations under Royal Decree 1627/1997 where construction works are performed, and maintain workplace emergency, training, maintenance, and inspection records.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Agencia Estatal de Administración Tributaria (AEAT) – Sede Electrónica: sede.agenciatributaria.gob.es
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: A Spanish Sociedad de Responsabilidad Limitada (SL) is identified by its NIF (Número de Identificación Fiscal). When the SL is established, the incorporators apply for the provisional NIF using Form 036/037 before the notary and commercial registry filing. After registration, the definitive NIF is issued by AEAT. For a foreign parent entity without a permanent establishment in Spain, the foreign entity must obtain a non-resident NIF (NIF-N) through Form 030, designating a Spanish tax representative if required by the circumstances, before invoicing or acquiring Spanish assets. For VAT purposes, the SL is separately registered for Spanish VAT (IVA) and obtains an IVA identification number, including the ES prefix for intra-Community transactions. The application is made electronically via AEAT’s Sede Electrónica with the company’s deed, statutory representation, and foreign parent’s certificate of incorporation, apostilled and translated into Spanish.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: Spain applies a classical entity-level corporate income tax (Impuesto sobre Sociedades) with no check-the-box or full pass-through election for SLs. Available optional regimes include: tax consolidation for groups meeting the 70% or 75% voting-control threshold (with mandatory consolidated group election filed to AEAT); reduced rate and cash-basis VAT election for SMEs; R&D tax credit monetization election; patent box regime election on qualifying IP income; and certain ATAD-compliant hybrid mismatch exclusions requiring documentation. An SL may also elect to depreciate fixed assets on an accelerated basis under specific R&D or environmental investment rules. No entity-level US-style classification election exists; the SL is by default tax resident and fully taxable in Spain if effectively managed or incorporated there.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: VAT (Impuesto sobre el Valor Añadido, IVA)
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: No general EUR-denominated registration threshold exists for domestic taxable activities; any person habitually carrying out supplies of goods or services in Spain must register for VAT from the first transaction. For cross-border distance sales of goods to final consumers, the intra-Community annual threshold of EUR 10,000 applies; exceeding it mandates registration or use of the One-Stop Shop (OSS) scheme.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: Mandatory business-to-business electronic invoicing is phased in under Ley Antifraude (Law 11/2021): all B2B invoices must be machine-readable and transmitted via interoperable e-invoicing systems. Large enterprises with annual turnover exceeding EUR 6 million are subject to the Suministro Inmediato de Información (SII) real-time VAT reporting regime, whereby VAT books are submitted electronically to AEAT within four calendar days of invoice issuance. Since 2024, certified billing software (Verifactu) must record invoice integrity and report QR/hash events; however, there is no real-time fiscal clearance or stamping requirement equivalent to the Italian Sistema di Interscambio. Taxpayers using EDIFACT or Facturae XML for SII are exempt from Verifactu if data is fully transmitted.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Export of goods to destinations outside the European Union qualifies for the 0% VAT rate provided the physical dispatch or transport is documented as leaving the EU and the exporter retains proof of export. For data center electromechanical EPC services physically performed on goods installed and consumed in Spain, the services are generally subject to Spanish VAT at the standard rate; zero-rating applies only where goods are exported after installation or where the service qualifies as an ancillary transport service linked to exported goods. Supplies of services to an overseas business customer may be outside the scope of Spanish VAT under the B2B reverse-charge rule if the place of supply is the customer’s jurisdiction; the supplier must obtain and validate the customer’s valid VAT/GST identification number and keep documentary evidence. Intra-Community supplies to an EU customer with a valid Spanish or other EU VAT ID are exempt (rather than zero-rated) if the EC Sales List is filed and the transport to another Member State is proven.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration (Documento Único Administrativo / DEX) validated by Spanish Customs
Bill of Lading (B/L), CMR road consignment note, or airway bill evidencing physical leaving of EU territory
Inward Remittance Certificate or bank statement showing receipt of foreign currency export proceeds
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: AEAT conducts strict audit review of export zero-rating claims, requiring complete transportation, customs, and payment evidence. Incorrect or fraudulent zero-rating gives rise to immediate VAT assessment at 21%, late-payment interest, and administrative penalties: a 50% surcharge for improperly documented claims rises to 150% where concealment or deliberate false documents are established. Continued non-compliance may trigger suspension of the NIF-VAT registration, joint and several liability for tax representatives, and criminal prosecution under the Spanish Criminal Code (delitos contra la Hacienda Pública) if the defrauded amount exceeds EUR 120,000, with penalties of up to six times the defrauded amount and custodial sentences for responsible officers.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: Spain operates under full capital and current account convertibility for the Euro. Profit remittances to non-resident shareholders are permitted without restriction following corporate tax compliance, AML verification, and submission of audited financial statements and tax clearance certificates. No capital controls apply to EUR transactions.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: Export receipts denominated in EUR require no mandatory surrender. Non-EUR export proceeds must be repatriated to Spain within 30 days of shipment and converted to EUR at the official Bank of Spain reference rate or prevailing market rate.

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Offshore digital EMIs are not viable for Spanish SL entities due to strict AML, banking secrecy, and payment institution licensing requirements under Spanish and EU law; all cross-border flows must route exclusively through licensed Spanish commercial banks or authorized payment service providers.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Directors (administradores) must attend physical KYC interviews at the bank branch for onboarding of SL companies with significant operations; remote video KYC is permitted only for low-value operational accounts under specific regulatory conditions.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Unusual transaction patterns or high cash flows inconsistent with business activity
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Detailed business plan, client contracts, EPC agreements, financial projections, and source of funds documentation

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Non-resident ownership with complex corporate structures
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Beneficial ownership declaration, corporate documents, tax residency proofs, and shareholder agreements

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Inbound capital injections via SWIFT MT103 with purpose code 'CAPITAL CONTRIBUTION' or 'EQTY'. Verification requires company incorporation certificate, shareholder agreements, bank reference letters, and beneficial ownership declarations.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Outbound disbursements use SWIFT MT103 with purpose code 'TRADE PAYMENT'. For international EPC contracts, Commercial Letters of Credit are recommended for supplier settlements to mitigate FX and credit risk.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Currency swaps and cross-currency interest rate swaps

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 3 months after financial year-end (e.g., 31 March for calendar year)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Fines up to 3,000 EUR per month of delay; administrative dissolution risk if unresolved within 1 year

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Modelo 347 Annual Transactions with Third Parties
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Administrative fines up to 6,000 EUR; potential criminal sanctions for serious non-compliance

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually or within 1 month of any ownership change
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Administrative fines of 3,000 EUR; register suspension and potential dissolution

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: Mandatory independent audit if net turnover exceeds 2 million EUR, total assets exceed 1 million EUR, or average number of employees exceeds 50
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: Spanish General Accounting Plan (Plan General de Contabilidad) aligned with local GAAP and IFRS for listed entities

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: Annual review and confirmation of beneficial ownership information in the Registro de Beneficiarios Finales with updates required within 1 month of changes

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.registered_office_or_agent_market_range_: 30-150 USD annually for registered office or agent services
recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: 200-2,000 USD for certified audit if required

corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: 25% base rate with deductions for R&D investments, innovation, and regional development programs

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Modelo 100 (Annual Corporate Income Tax Return) via Agencia Tributaria electronic portal
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: 25 days after end of tax year (e.g., 25 January for 31 December fiscal year-end)

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Net taxable income before adjustments and incentives
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Report Spanish-source income only; non-residents file as non-resident taxpayers

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Apply headline rate to taxable base
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: 25% rate applied to net taxable income; withholdings credited
Non-residents claim credits for taxes withheld on dividends, royalties, and interest

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: 100 EUR per day of delay (maximum 1,500 EUR); additional 0.5% of tax due per month of delay; criminal sanctions for willful non-filing

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: Submit Treaty Relief Certificate (TRC) application to Agencia Tributaria with beneficial ownership certificate and DTA substantiation prior to dividend payment
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Royalties: 19% statutory rate, reduced to 0-10% under applicable DTAs; Interest: 19% statutory rate, reduced to 0-10% under DTAs (e.g., 0% for certain treaty partners)

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: Not applicable to data center EPC activities; transposed EU Economic Substance Directive applies only to financial services and IP holding entities

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Failing to file returns or submitting false information to understate taxable income
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Criminal penalties: fines up to 100% of evaded tax plus imprisonment up to 5 years
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Piercing the corporate veil; directors face personal criminal liability, fines, and possible disqualification from business activities

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Operating a shell entity without real economic activity or substance
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Administrative fines up to 300,000 EUR; potential company dissolution and asset seizure
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Personal restitution obligations; possible criminal charges for fraudulent incorporation or management

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Failure to prepare or follow TP documentation or apply arm's length principle
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Fines up to 1 million EUR or 5% of group turnover; tax reassessment and interest charges
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Personal liability for gross negligence or willful misconduct; possible disqualification

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Misdeclaration of repatriated profits or failure to withhold and remit WHT on dividends, royalties, or interest
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: WHT evasion fines up to 100% of unpaid tax plus criminal sanctions
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Personal criminal liability, imprisonment, and civil restitution duties
